name: Dan's Drive-In (Montpelier, ID) Crispy Golden Tater Tots or Fresh Home-Cut Fries
whyItWorks: Idaho russet potatoes are naturally low-residue and easily digestible when well-cooked. Dan's cuts their fries fresh daily. Modest portions are well tolerated in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a regular size fresh-cut fries or tater tots with light salt; dip in mild ketchup rather than spiced fry sauce.
watchOuts: Deep-fry oil can accelerate bowel transit during acute flares
